fairness_definition: Rows are comparable only when they use the same FOREST train/valid/test files, the same observation ratios, the same train/eval cascade caps, the same epochs/batch/hidden/sequence configuration, the same candidate policy, and the same metric implementation.
claim_boundary: This file is the fair learned matrix. The earlier stable SOTA matrix remains an engineering run record and must not be used as a direct learned-model improvement verdict.

excluded_methods.reason: The current adapter calls SplitData(..., train_rate=0.8, valid_rate=0.1), so its split and all-position sequence metrics do not match the FOREST split + obs-ratio window protocol.
excluded_methods.path_to_fix: Add a native MINDS fair adapter that consumes explicit train/valid/test cascades and evaluates prefix windows.

excluded_methods.reason: The current temporal-graph adapter can run upstream training, but event-level Top-K metrics are still computed by protocol_next_hop_baseline(), a shared transition/popularity proxy rather than learned scores.
excluded_methods.path_to_fix: Extract learned temporal-node scores at each prefix window and rank the same train-user candidate universe.

excluded_methods.reason: The current TGN adapter exports temporal edges and launches self-supervised training, but does not feed learned TGN scores into the macro/micro event-window evaluator.
excluded_methods.path_to_fix: Add a TGN prefix-state scorer and use the shared Top-K metric implementation.

excluded_methods.reason: CasFT is a macro future-trend/size model and has no next-user Top-K head in the current protocol.
excluded_methods.path_to_fix: Evaluate CasFT in a separate macro-only table using the same FOREST split and observed prefix windows.

excluded_methods.reason: The current adapter targets public-code smoke/full-run behavior, not the shared prefix-window sampled-softmax metric implementation used here.
excluded_methods.path_to_fix: Wrap FOREST logits/rollouts into the shared prefix-window evaluator before including it in this verdict.

training_protocol.backbone: MINDS-style trainable DynamicCasHGNN + RelationGNN + SharedLSTM sequence state
training_protocol.loss_normalization: per-window losses are grouped by cascade event_id, averaged per cascade, then averaged across cascades
training_protocol.rollout: autoregressive multi-step rollout aggregated into future-window Top-K
training_protocol.trend_decoder: CasFT-style Euler latent dynamics with positive cumulative increments

rows.methodology: Same-protocol MINDS-style trainable baseline: DynamicCasHGNN, RelationGNN, SharedLSTM, adversarial stage objective, and macro/micro heads. It disables the KT2-specific FOREST soft coupling and CasFT-style trend supervision so it can be compared under the same split/window/metric implementation.
rows.legacy_boundary: This formal model replaces the legacy candidate-row KT2JointModel path; prefix+candidate feature rows are retained only for ablation.

research_migration.MINDS: Primary backbone orientation: dynamic cascade hypergraph, social graph, and shared sequence state.
research_migration.FOREST: Soft coupling uses expected micro rollout growth as an auxiliary macro trend signal.
research_migration.CasFT: Continuous trend head predicts monotonic future cumulative size checkpoints.
